verdict.rationale: Superhuman's docs say that if your email needs a response, you are automatically reminded to follow up, with a draft ready to send. Its MCP integration can also check which emails were read and draft nudges. However, nothing in the evidence documents snoozing conversations, and the mechanism that resurfaces a thread when nobody replies is not described in detail. Missing for 10: any documented snooze capability, details on how unanswered threads resurface in the inbox (timing and controls), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: If your email needs a response, you’re automatically reminded to follow up—with a draft already written and ready to send.
Get an email assistant that automatically labels incoming emails, archives low-priority messages, drafts replies, and reminds you to follow up.
Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it.
